message: 自分のものに
November is drawing to a close. By this time next month, the Holy Night Festival will already be over.
When that time comes, will I be smiling with a clear conscience? Or will I be wallowing in lingering regrets?
I ponder this as I climb the main approach to Asukai Shrine.

name: Paqy
message: 「As long as your goal's crystal clear, there's no need to have regrets even if you fail.」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess you're right. Though of course, I'm going to do my absolute best to make it succeed.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's guaranteed to be a huge success!」

name: Synn
message: 「How can you say that with so much certainty?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Inside the Demon Lord's heart, Re-Crea--which could wipe out all three realms--and a single academy's Holy Night Festival carry the exact same weight, don't they?」

name: Paqy
message: 「With a big shot like that serving as commander, there's no way you're gonna screw it up!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That flattery makes me itch. Besides, that might just be proof that I've lost touch with reality.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Reality, huh? Well, let's see...」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're heading to the shrine to pray for the Holy Night Festival and psych yourself up, right... Do you even have any offering money?」

name: Synn
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Walking up the shrine path while asleep--truly worthy of the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!? S-Sorry about that!」
Walking down the deserted shrine approach with my eyes closed, I ended up bumping into someone.
...What is this?

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena, currently having her cleavage toyed with by Synn-chan\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugyaaaahhhhhhh!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, how mean~. You don't have to jump back that dramatically, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Aah, augh, augh, s-shiver, t-tremble!」

name: Helena
message: 「Calm down. You were lost in thought, weren't you, Synn-chan? I don't mind.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew.」

name: Helena
message: 「Though in another era, this would be the part where you gracefully take responsibility and become my husband.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? You're assuming I'd be marrying into your family?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, if you marry me and live under the same roof of the Kujou household, you'll become siblings-in-law with Ria, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'd become Ria-senpai's big brother?」

name: Ria
message: 「Big brother, big brother♪ Big brother\s04 Big brother\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Big brother? Big brother... Big brother!? Big brother!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Big brother, big brother! Big brother!! Big brotheeeeeeer」

name: Synn
message: 「...It sounds like all kinds of trouble would happen, so please spare me the marriage at least」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, even though it sounds quite fun, the chairwoman is sad, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「Once Synn-chan grows into a rugged, mature man, come and claim my boobs again, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh... Please. Get off the topic of your chest」

name: Helena
message: 「Because I'm bored until Tamiko-chan gets back」

name: Synn
message: 「How unusual... Are you meeting up with Riesling-san at the shrine?」

name: Helena
message: 「No. Tamiko-chan and I came together to pay our respects. I'm here to pray for the Holy Night Festival... You too, right, Synn-chan?」

name: Helena
message: 「It seems Tamiko-chan had some personal errand deep in the shrine grove. She just got back a moment ago」

name: Synn
message: 「Then the two of you are already done with your business, huh. Looks like we just missed each other」

name: Helena
message: 「I am, yes. However, Tamiko-chan's true personal matter isn't finished yet」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, I don't see Riesling-san anywhere」

name: Helena
message: 「When one finds a rough gem, one wants to polish it. Just like I do with Synn-chan, Ria, and the Crusader girls」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Helena, a fine shrine visit to you」

name: Shio
message: 「And to you too, Old Man... ngh, a f-fine...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Shio-chan, your naginata is unsheathed, you know? That's dangerous」

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan's handiwork, isn't it?」

name: Riesling
message: 「You flatter me」

name: Shio
message: 「Nobody is praising you! Did you come here just to make a fool of me, Old Man!?」

name: Shio
message: 「I only lent you my beloved blade, Kogitsunemaru, because you claimed you would show me 48 practical naginata forms!」

name: Shio
message: 「A-And yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「There doesn't seem to be anything wrong with the naginata, though?」

name: Shio
message: 「It is Sir Jiiya who is extraordinary!」

name: Shio
message: 「Aside from the very first form, the rest are too difficult to imitate! Nay, they were so swift I could not even discern them!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lord Shio, please remember only the first form and forget all the rest」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What did you say!? Then wouldn't the remaining 47 moves be meaningless!?」

name: Helena
message: 「They do have meaning」

name: Helena
message: 「Just like that, forgetting everything other than the fundamentals--for now, that's the right thing to do」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's right」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it's hard to explain, but she's right」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What profound words...」

name: Shio
message: 「How shameful... I jumped to the conclusion that Sir Jiiya would impart master techniques to me, and got carried away all by myself」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right too. Making assumptions can be scary, yet nothing ever starts unless you believe in something first」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Helena...」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san...」

name: Shio
message: 「Hm, why is even Sir Synn looking so deeply impressed?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got a lot going on too, you know」
Like stuff with the Demon Lord....

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu\s04 If Shio-chan wants to master something right away... provided a different set of 48 moves is fine, I can take you by the hand and feet and teach you nice and slowly♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Though Shio-chan is a bit too strict for me. So, right? Synn-chan\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「A different set...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It goes right over you brats' heads. She means dirty stuff」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's what it was--」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What!? Please, spare me that secret technique for another time...」

name: Helena
message: 「Fohoho. We'll leave the rest to the two youngsters and head back to the academy」

name: Riesling
message: 「Farewell then」

name: Shio
message: 「U-Uuuugh. The ironclad old butler is leaving... Th-Then I must perform the forty-eight lewd positions upon Lord Synn...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaah!? What are you doing all of a sudden」

name: Shio
message: 「A maiden has things she wishes to protect, you see. Also, might you allow me to test out the form I just learned?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way!」

name: Shio
message: 「Now, now, don't say that」
Running away from Shio-chan, I dash down the shrine approach.
Although I couldn't make my prayer wish, perhaps thanks to getting some decent exercise, I stopped brooding and moping over all sorts of things.
Helena-san probably foresaw this far ahead when she teased us.
